getting-started-talking-to-brother-omad.speaker: Brother Omad
getting-started-talking-to-brother-omad.text: yawn*...oh, hello...*yawn* I'm sorry! I'm just so tired! I haven't slept in a week!

options.text: Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?

steps.player: Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?

steps.speaker: Brother Omad
steps.text: It's brother Androe's son! With his constant: Waaaaaah! Waaaaaaaaah! Androe said it's natural, but it's so annoying!

steps.player: I suppose that's what kids do.

steps.speaker: Brother Omad
steps.text: He was fine, up until last week! Thieves broke in! They stole his favourite sleeping blanket!

steps.speaker: Brother Omad
steps.text: Now he won't rest until it's returned... ...and that means neither can I!

steps.speaker: Brother Omad
steps.text: Please do. We won't be able to help you as we are peaceful men but we would be grateful for your help!

steps.speaker: Brother Omad
steps.text: They hide in a secret cave in the forest. It's hidden under a ring of stones. Please, bring back the blanket!

steps.player: I'm sorry to hear that! I hope you find his blanket.

options.text: Sorry! I'm too busy to hear your problems!

steps.player: Sorry! I'm too busy to hear your problems!

getting-started-talking-to-brother-omad-.speaker: Brother Omad
getting-started-talking-to-brother-omad-.text: Please tell me you have the blanket.

child-s-blanket-talking-to-brother-omad-.speaker: Brother Omad
child-s-blanket-talking-to-brother-omad-.text: Please tell me you have the blanket.

child-s-blanket-talking-to-brother-omad-.player: Yes! I've recovered it from the clutches of the evil thieves!

child-s-blanket-talking-to-brother-omad-.text: You hand the monk the childs blanket.

child-s-blanket-talking-to-brother-omad-.speaker: Brother Omad
child-s-blanket-talking-to-brother-omad-.text: Really, that's excellent, well done! Maybe now I will be able to get some rest.

child-s-blanket-talking-to-brother-omad-.speaker: Brother Omad
child-s-blanket-talking-to-brother-omad-.text: yawn*..I'm off to bed! Farewell brave traveller! {{^|Here is where he actually takes the blanket.}}

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Honey, money, woman and wine!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Yesshh...hic up...beautiful!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: La..di..da..hic..up!
The old monk has had too much to drink.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.speaker: Brother Omad
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.text: Much better now I'm sleeping well! Now I can organise the party.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.speaker: Brother Omad
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.text: The son of Brother Androe's birthday party. He's going to be one year old!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.speaker: Brother Omad
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.text: It's also a great excuse for a drink!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.speaker: Brother Omad
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.text: We just need Brother Cedric to return with the wine.

steps.speaker: Brother Omad
steps.text: Cedric is a member of the order too. We sent him out three days ago to collect wine. But he didn't return!

steps.speaker: Brother Omad
steps.text: He most probably got drunk and lost in the forest!

steps.speaker: Brother Omad
steps.text: I don't suppose you could look for him?

options.text: I've no time for that, sorry.

steps.player: I've no time for that, sorry.

steps.speaker: Brother Omad
steps.text: Oh, he won't be far. Probably out in the forest.

steps.player: Ok, I'll go and find him.

options.text: Can I come to the party?

steps.player: Can I come to the party?

steps.speaker: Brother Omad
steps.text: Of course, but we need the wine first.

options.text: Enjoy it! I'll see you soon!

steps.player: Enjoy it! I'll see you soon!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-b.speaker: Brother Omad
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-b.text: Hello adventurer, have you found Brother Cedric?

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-b.speaker: Brother Omad
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-b.text: Well, keep looking, we need that wine!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Yeesshhh, I'm very, very drunk..hic..up..

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.player: Brother Omad needs the wine for the party.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Oh dear, oh dear, I knew I had to do something!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Pleashhh, find me a jug of water. Once I'm sober I'll 'elp you take the wine back.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Hic up! Oh my head! I need a jug of water.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.player: I'll see if I can get some.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Thanks! *hic*

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.speaker: Brother Omad
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.text: Hello adventurer, have you found Brother Cedric?

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.player: Yes I've seen him, he's a bit drunk!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.speaker: Brother Omad
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.text: Well, try your best to get him back here!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Hic up! Oh my head! I need a jug of water.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.player: Cedric! Here, drink! I have some water.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Good stuff, my head's spinning!
You hand the monk a jug of water.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Gulp... gulp!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Aah! That's better!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Now I just need to fix this cart and we can go party.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Could you help?

options.text: No, I've helped enough monks today!

steps.player: No, I've helped enough monks today!

steps.speaker: Brother Cedric
steps.text: In that case I'd better drink more wine! It helps me think.

steps.speaker: Brother Cedric
steps.text: Excellent, I just need some wood. Some plain logs, or maybe a basic plank.

steps.player: OK, I'll see what I can find.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Now I just need to fix this cart and we can go party.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Could you help?

options.text: No, I've helped enough monks today!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.player: He's having a bit of trouble with his cart.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Did you manage to get some wood?

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Did you manage to get some wood?
If the player has logs:
If the player has a plank:

steps.text: You show Cedric a wooden plank.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Well done! Now I'll fix this cart. You head back to Brother Omad and tell him I'll be there soon.

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.speaker: Brother Cedric
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-cedric.text: Hi, I'm almost done here. Could you tell Omad that I'll be back soon?

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.player: Hi Omad, Brother Cedric is on his way!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.speaker: Brother Omad
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.text: Good! Good! Now we can party!

brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.speaker: Brother Omad
brother-cedric-talking-to-brother-omad-a.text: I have little to repay you with but please, take these runes.

post-quest-dialogue-for-20-minutes-talki.speaker: Brother Omad
post-quest-dialogue-for-20-minutes-talki.text: Dum dee do la la! *hiccup* That was some party!
